title: PICO Voice Evaluation Corpus Manifest
description: Canonical metadata, provenance, licensing, and ground-truth transcripts for local STT qualification corpora.
qualification_scope_limitation: Per project owner approval on 2026-11-20 (Option B, Proposal 0006), formal GATE-VOICE-02 accuracy qualification requires naturally spoken recordings of the four canonical command texts spoken by a consenting human operator using a physical microphone under standard room acoustics (16 kHz 16-bit mono signed PCM WAV). Demographic quotas (5-10 speakers) were removed as specification drift. Formal human command recordings are currently PENDING acquisition and registration. The synthetic SAPI clips in smoke_test_clips remain deterministic automated CI regression fixtures and cannot satisfy formal GATE-VOICE-02 qualification. Passing the four-command human corpus provides empirical evidence strictly for the canonical commands, tested speaker, microphone, and pinned STT model/runtime, and does NOT constitute proof of general multi-speaker, accent, or unconstrained conversational robustness.
